_doc: Seasonal event calendar. Each event: id, theme (folder, default = id), type (what players can switch off, default = id).
Names: '<family>' or '<family>-<sub>'. A sub-event (sinterklaas-intocht) takes theme/type/priority from its family's main event
(sinterklaas) unless it sets its own; a date in it may be {'of': 'start'|'date'|'end'} = the main event's. On its days the engine
gets its name as manifest 'event', so the theme can do something special. Config themes_force / themes_disabled_types take a
family ('sinterklaas': all of it), a single id ('sinterklaas-intocht') or a type.
dict forms take 'offset': N days and 'move': {'sun': -1} (on a Sunday a day earlier);
date = (first) prime day; prime_days = how many prime days; prime_level = the level on them (default 8);
start/end or lead_days/after_days = run-up/fade-out. Windows may run over new year.
The run-up climbs from level lead_min to lead_max (default 1..7) as progress**curve.
Overlaps: a prime day wins, then higher priority, then higher level, then a sub-event over its main event.
Events whose theme folder has no theme.json are skipped. Check: python3 tools/calendar_check.py
